title: ErrorResponse
description: Thin structured error envelope emitted by `duckduckgo-search-cli` on some failure paths. Generated from `src/error::CliError`. v0.9.8: many failures instead emit a full SearchOutput envelope via failure_output/error_output (see search-output.schema.json + search-metadata.schema.json), which already carries agent chrome fields. This thin schema remains for the residual thin error path; when `metadata` is present it may include best-effort chrome agent metadata (not telemetry). Wire keys: English default (v1.0.2 / ADR-0027); PT aliases accepted on deserialize.

next_action_suggestion.description: v1.0.3: agent-actionable remediation for this failure, when one is known. Emitted by the `deep-research` pre-flight validation paths.

result_count.description: v1.0.3: always 0. Emitted on failure paths of a *search* invocation so a caller reads the same shape on success and on failure, without branching on envelope kind.

results.description: v1.0.3: always empty. Companion of `result_count`; see its description.

metadata.description: Best-effort partial metadata even on failure (v0.7.10 GAP-WS-60 + GAP-AUD-001). v0.9.8 agent contract (not telemetry): may also include chrome resolution fields on failure envelopes. Prefer full SearchOutput failure envelopes when present — those carry the complete SearchMetadata chrome contract.

retries.description: Retries attempted before failure. v1.0.3: renamed from the Portuguese `retentativas`, which was the only PT spelling left in an otherwise English schema and therefore never matched the default wire (ADR-0027). `--wire-keys pt` still emits `retentativas_executadas`.

used_chrome.description: v0.9.8 agent contract (not telemetry): honest flag whether Chrome was used before failure.

chrome_path_resolved.description: v0.9.8 agent contract (not telemetry): resolved Chrome/Chromium binary path after shell/Flatpak resolution, when known on the failure path.

chrome_channel.description: v0.9.8+ agent contract (not telemetry): install channel of the resolved browser when known on the failure path (no env channel).
